evidence: Receiving P assay t=36h = 1.27 g/L vs sources 1.02-1.12 g/L
Receiving P assay t=48h = 3.48 g/L vs sources 2.98-3.06 g/L
Receiving DO2 at t=52h = 11.1 mg/L, matching source range 10.8-11.5 mg/L
Minimum receiving DO2 observed ~8.2 mg/L (t~24-28h dip), far above 2.0 mg/L constraint
Source batches reached P~8.0-8.4 g/L peak at t=72-84h with essentially identical DO2 trajectory
args.rationale: Receiving batch is healthy and performing at or above the source-batch trajectory (P=3.48 g/L at t=48h vs sources 2.98-3.06; DO2 11.1 mg/L at t=52h matching sources). DO2 never approached the 2.0 mg/L constraint (observed min ~8.2 mg/L). This appears to be a normal case requiring no intervention; feed reduction or aeration increase would add risk without expected benefit, and a stop yields zero production.
args.uncertainty: Assay data lag 4h and source/receiving process parameters may differ (hidden states unavailable). Growth could be marginally faster/slower than sources, but the large DO2 headroom means KEEP carries no oxygen-violation risk under the observed trajectory. No extra assay was needed since the DO2 trace through t=52h already matches sources.
